Gideon called both lanes working at **11:07 AM** on 3 Aug. He posted that at 11:08 AM, and the message says "as of Aug 3, 11:07."

The first check-in after kiosk 1 came back was **trailer 8836**. Mateo reported it at 11:03 AM: "Kiosk 1 is back. Guard checked in trailer 8836; dispatch sees it."

Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, messages from Mateo Quiroga at 11:03 AM and Gideon Sato at 11:08 AM on 3 Aug.
